about_the_game:
A distant star civilization has decided that your world looks… conquerable. Aliens pour from the skies, and somehow, you’re the one in charge of stopping them. In Aliens Falling from the Sky?, every decision matters as you try to hold the line against increasingly ridiculous odds.

Build powerful towers, upgrade their abilities, and craft deadly defenses to stop the invasion in its tracks. Every battlefield demands smart placement, quick thinking, and a carefully planned approach.

With diverse enemies, evolving challenges, and endless strategic possibilities, no two battles ever feel the same. Aliens Falling from the Sky? delivers a thrilling tower defense experience for both newcomers and seasoned commanders.

Ready to show the invaders they picked the wrong planet? The ultimate test of your tactical skills awaits. Stand your ground — your world is counting on you.
